decision: Do not integrate this narrow WASM kernel into the production 80386 executor

workload.name: stock xv6-public forktest, 4 MiB, Bochs BIOS
workload.command: XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs

method: Temporary counters on successful guest instruction retirement grouped contiguous register-only MOV 89, CMP 39, and TEST 85 forms supported by the spike. Counters and modified executor were restored after this completed run; this receipt records the result but is not a source-bound instrumentation artifact.

spike.description: Static precompiled WASM kernel for bounded, prevalidated register-only MOV, CMP, TEST and NOP IR; no guest fetch, memory access, or board integration

conclusion: Almost every eligible run is one instruction. A JS-to-WASM call for this subset would cross the boundary almost once per guest instruction; the narrow subset cannot materially advance the 10x target. No end-to-end WASM A/B was run and no emulator speedup is claimed. Broader memory, branch and string execution plus precise events, faults and code/page-table coherence are prerequisites for a production block path.
